userStories.title: Validate apply_profile keys against dataclass fields
userStories.description: apply_profile uses setattr for all profile dict keys — typos silently create new attributes. Validate against known fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Only setattr keys that exist as ScannerConfig fields
Existing behavior preserved for valid keys

userStories.title: Add file locking fallback in _append_journal_entry
userStories.description: When safe_json_write is unavailable, the fallback uses write_text without file locking. Multiple concurrent processes may corrupt the journal.
acceptanceCriteria: Fallback path uses fcntl file locking if available
userStories.notes: PASS — fallback uses fcntl.LOCK_EX file locking, graceful fallback if fcntl unavailable

userStories.title: Escalate _run_smart_loop outer exception to warning level
userStories.description: The outer except Exception in _run_smart_loop uses logger.debug — hides all trading loop errors. Should be logger.warning.
acceptanceCriteria: Change logger.debug to logger.warning for outer smart loop exception
userStories.notes: PASS — outer smart loop exception escalated from debug to warning with exc_info=True

userStories.title: Guard _run_learning_loop journal parse and optimize read
userStories.description: Line 1108: json.loads without try/except. Also reads entire journal every sync — should only process last N entries.
acceptanceCriteria: Wrap json.loads in try/except with graceful return
Only process last trades_synced entries instead of all closed trades
userStories.notes: PASS — journal parse guarded with try/except, only processes last trades_synced entries
